template: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA {schema} GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO haloflow_runtime; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA {schema} GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO haloflow_runtime; CREATE TABLE {schema}.access_audit_outbox ( source_event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, action_code varchar(64) NOT NULL, resource_class varchar(64) NOT NULL, purpose_code varchar(64) NOT NULL, outcome_code varchar(64) NOT NULL, principal_kind varchar(16) NOT NULL, principal_id varchar(128) NOT NULL, execution_id uuid NOT NULL, request_id varchar(128), occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT statement_timestamp(), projected_at timestamptz, CONSTRAINT access_audit_outbox_principal_kind CHECK (principal_kind IN ('actor', 'workload')) ); CREATE INDEX access_audit_outbox_projection_idx ON {schema}.access_audit_outbox (projected_at, occurred_at); GRANT SELECT ON {schema}.access_audit_outbox TO haloflow_audit_projector; COMMENT ON TABLE {schema}.access_audit_outbox IS 'M01 classification: pseudonymous-id; PHI prohibited';
